description: §15.10 (S458 "D1") — a component body writes a root (or inner) attribute FROM a same-named declared prop explicitly: `href=${href}`, `href=href`, quoted `href="/p${href}"`, and an inner `<a href=${href}>`. None fires E-COMPONENT-012, and each attribute carries the CALLER's value — an `${expr}` caller, a bare `@cell` caller (reactive: it follows the cell), a literal caller, and an `<each>` row member. Pins the two explicit-write miscompiles the S458 deep-dive found (an `${expr}` caller left the body's `href` unbound) and the quoted-attribute source-text splice (`/p@u`, g-component-prop-in-quoted-attr-substitutes-source-text-s456).
rationale: §15.10: 'A root attribute that carries a VALUE and a declared prop's name … is the component body writing its own root attribute, not a second declaration, and SHALL NOT fire E-COMPONENT-012.' §15.10.1: prop references are substituted with the caller-side value at every position, so the written attribute holds the caller's value.
